## Featured Cybersecurity Projects
- [RazorShield AI](https://cyber-jabez.github.io/PORTFOLIO/projects.html#razorshield): AI-driven fraud detection & behavioral anomaly engine monitoring financial transaction flows in real time. Built with Python, Scikit-learn, FastAPI, and Docker.
- [Phishing-Guard Heuristic Engine](https://cyber-jabez.github.io/PORTFOLIO/projects.html#phishing-guard): Multi-layer phishing detection system evaluating DOM tree mutation, SSL trust chains, and lexical heuristics to intercept malicious endpoints before payload execution.
- [HNX-Vision](https://cyber-jabez.github.io/PORTFOLIO/projects.html#hnx-vision): Automated threat surface discovery and vulnerability reconnaissance dashboard aggregating asset inventory and CVE severity metrics.
- [PassEntropy](https://cyber-jabez.github.io/PORTFOLIO/projects.html#passentropy): Shannon-entropy password strength auditor and dictionary breach verifier built for defense against credential stuffing attacks.

- **Cloud & Infrastructure**: AWS (IAM, VPC, CloudWatch, GuardDuty), Docker, Linux Containers, NGINX, Git, Zero-Trust Architecture.
- **Languages & Scripting**: Python, Bash Shell Scripting, C/C++, JavaScript, SQL.
- **Network Security**: TCP/IP stack analysis, VLAN segmentation, TLS 1.3/SSL analysis, packet capture analysis, DNSSEC.
